payload.claim: This backlog record says `saffron/phases/implement.py` restates the runner's `_STEP_USAGE_KEYS` tuple at `saffron/phases/implement.py:128`. This diff deletes that restatement entirely and moves the tuple to `saffron/events.py` as public `STEP_USAGE_KEYS`, so implement.py no longer restates it at all and the cited line numbers (119, 128) no longer point at that code. Anyone picking up b-0efc31 to write 'a test that reads both modules' tuples' will be reading a stale description of where the second tuple lives.
